content.short: XOCIETY is a high-fidelity AAA "POP" shooter on Sui featuring an immersive player-driven virtual economy.
content.description:
XOCIETY is a premier AAA-quality decentralized third-person shooter developed by industry veterans, designed to bring professional-grade gaming to the high-performance Sui blockchain. The game features "POP" (Procedural Outbreak PvP) mechanics, blending intense action combat with deep RPG elements and a rich narrative campaign. XOCIETY stands out for its immersive virtual economy, where every in-game action—from resource gathering to competitive combat—directly influences the broader player-driven market.

As a flagship title for the SuiPlay0X1 handheld device, where it comes pre-installed, XOCIETY focuses on player sovereignty and community-driven development. The ecosystem provides players with true digital ownership of their NFT-based equipment, weapons, and progress, all secured by Sui's sub-second transaction finality. Through its combination of high-action gameplay and innovative rewards, XOCIETY is building a more interactive and meritocratic virtual world for the next generation of gamers, where effort is recognized as a primary on-chain asset.
content.meta: XOCIETY offers AAA extraction shooter gameplay and a player-driven virtual economy on the Sui blockchain.
